_comment: User-editable settings. Edit values here — no need to touch Python code. Secrets go in .env, NOT here.

vision._camera_controls_comment: Optional Picamera2 quality controls applied after the camera starts. Safe to remove or adjust. AWB modes: 0=Auto 1=Incandescent 2=Tungsten 3=Fluorescent 4=Indoor 5=Daylight 6=Cloudy. Brightness: -1.0 to +1.0 (default 0.0). Contrast/Saturation/Sharpness: 0.0 to 32.0 (default 1.0). Remove this block entirely to use camera defaults.

ui._layout_comment: Portrait mode for the Pi 7-inch screen in vertical orientation. Set portrait to false for landscape (small thumbnail instead of large preview).
ui._mirror_comment: Mirror the live camera preview so it looks like a selfie camera. Set to false for a raw (non-mirrored) view. Detection is never affected.

conversation._comment: How long the robot stays in conversation mode after the person stops talking or leaves.
conversation._max_session_comment: Set max_session_seconds to a number (e.g. 300) to limit session length, or leave null for unlimited.

wave_detection._comment: Lightweight wave-gesture detection. When the user waves, the screen shows 'User is waving'. Set enabled to false to turn it off.
wave_detection._threshold_comment: motion_threshold: 0-255, higher = less sensitive. min_motion_frames: how many frames of motion before confirming a wave.

question_logging._comment: Optional text-only log of questions and answers for improving the robot. Logs to logs/questions.csv. Never logs audio, images, faces, or personal data.

servo._comment: Single 180-degree pan servo for the head. It moves ONLY on a voice command (e.g. 'look left', 'look forward') — it does NOT auto-follow the camera. Signal -> GPIO 18 (physical pin 12), power -> external 5V, ground -> shared GND. Set enabled to false if no servo is connected.
servo._angle_comment: Full safe sweep range in degrees (180-degree servo = -90..90). Narrow these if the head hits something.
servo._voice_comment: How far 'look left'/'look right' turn from centre, in degrees. Kept below the full range as a safe limit so the head never swings too far.
servo._motion_comment: Smoothness controls. smoothing: fraction of remaining distance moved per tick (lower = gentler glide). max_speed_deg_per_sec caps turn speed (lower = slower). deadzone_deg = how close counts as arrived. wake_zone_deg = how big a change must be to start moving again.
servo._rest_comment: idle_release_seconds: once settled, wait this long then stop pulsing so the servo is silent.
servo._mount_comment: Set invert to true if the head turns the wrong way. Pulse widths suit a typical SG90; adjust if your servo's range is off.
